title: Session Stats
description: Track your session statistics in real-time with a client-side overlay.
body:
# Session Stats

A lightweight client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that tracks your session statistics in real-time.

## Features

✨ **Real-time Tracking**
- Blocks Mined
- Mobs Killed
- Deaths
- Items Crafted
- Damage Taken
- Items Picked Up
- Distance Walked
- Session Duration

🎯 **Personal Bests**
- All-time records for each stat
- Gold star (★) indicator for new personal bests
- Persistent storage across sessions

📊 **Session History**
- Automatically saves last 7 sessions
- Compare today's stats vs yesterday
- JSON format in .minecraft/sessionstats/

⚙️ **Customizable**
- Toggle individual stats on/off
- Easy JSON config file
- Non-intrusive overlay design

🔐 **Server-Friendly**
- Client-side only - works on ANY server
- No server-side mod required
- No AntiCheat issues
